kb/reports/P139.code_0.diff

commit 77c8cd91730d5af3648d2a716e08891983a74fab
Author: Seul Lee <ftk3187@athena.athena.research.northwestern.edu>
Date:   Tue Oct 20 03:47:27 2026 -0500

    P139 form: every field required and nullable
    
    form.json: every record property in required, every one also takes null (anyOf [schema,
    null]); no dependentRequired, no if/then requirement (the P138 statement rule deleted);
    value_text enum rules kept (null allowed). qualifiers keeps optional keys inside its
    nullable object (26 required qualifier keys would be 26 nulls per record). form_pass0.json:
    every item field required and nullable. FORM.md reads the nullable objects.
    common.provider_schema(): [X, null] -> X with "null" in its type (and None in its enum);
    other unions stay a string; required kept. form_roundtrip.cast(): reads the non-null
    branch of a nullable property.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

diff --git a/psed_v2/kb/extract/common.py b/psed_v2/kb/extract/common.py
index 15495e1..ea9eb9f 100644
--- a/psed_v2/kb/extract/common.py
+++ b/psed_v2/kb/extract/common.py
@@ -59,8 +59,16 @@ def provider_schema(s, defs=None):
     if defs is None and isinstance(s, dict):
         defs = s.get("$defs", {})
     if isinstance(s, dict):
-        if "anyOf" in s:
-            return {"type": "string"}
+        if "anyOf" in s:                                                        # P139: [X, null] -> X with null in its type (and enum); any other union a string
+            other = [x for x in s["anyOf"] if not (isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("type") == "null")]
+            out = provider_schema(other[0], defs) if len(other) == 1 else {"type": "string"}
+            if len(other) < len(s["anyOf"]):
+                out = dict(out)
+                t = out.get("type", "string")
+                out["type"] = (t if isinstance(t, list) else [t]) + ["null"]
+                if "enum" in out:
+                    out["enum"] = list(out["enum"]) + [None]
+            return out
         if "$ref" in s:
             return provider_schema(defs[s["$ref"].split("/")[-1]], defs)
         if len(s.get("enum", [])) > X.PROVIDER_ENUM_MAX:
diff --git a/psed_v2/kb/extract/form_roundtrip.py b/psed_v2/kb/extract/form_roundtrip.py
index 3dbf3d0..50445dd 100644
--- a/psed_v2/kb/extract/form_roundtrip.py
+++ b/psed_v2/kb/extract/form_roundtrip.py
@@ -40,6 +40,7 @@ def as_number(x):
 def cast(row, props):
     """facts.csv row -> (form record, [(field, reason)] for the columns the form cannot take)."""
     rec, lost = {}, []
+    props = {k: next((x for x in p.get("anyOf", []) if x.get("type") != "null"), p) if len(p.get("anyOf", [])) == 2 else p for k, p in props.items()}   # P139: nullable
     for c, v in row.items():
         if not v or c in X.COMPILER_ONLY:
             continue

commit 4a2cdf9f97f9bcf5e4a052ffd71529caec69d52f
Author: Seul Lee <ftk3187@athena.athena.research.northwestern.edu>
Date:   Tue Oct 20 03:47:27 2026 -0500

    P139 prompts: pass-0 series role and definitions, every field present
    
    pass 0: role list gains series; a simulation is one model (two solution methods or
    approximations of one model are the same simulation); a series is a figure's runs or
    specimens varying one quantity, parent required (null only when the paper gives none);
    every field present. Example: the last dev paper whose gold has a series comparison
    (zou23), every field present. Thinking stays MEDIUM.
    pass 1: "every field present; null when it does not apply"; examples carry every field;
    the response's variables list nullable; TYPES() reads the enum inside the nullable type.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

 One item per named thing:
 - id: a short id you assign, unique in the paper (r1, s1, sim1, ser1, c1, ...); pass 1 uses it as a record's parent;
 - name_as_printed: the name exactly as the paper prints it (copied, never rewritten or invented);

-  structure. A simulation is a model the paper solves, one item per model. A specimen is a physical sample the paper measures (a
-  coated structure, a film, a substrate piece). A series is a figure series: several model runs or specimens that differ in one
-  quantity (introduced_in = the figure). A cited work is another publication the paper names;
-- parent: for a specimen, the id of the run that made it; for a series, the id of its simulation, run or specimen;

+  a structure. A simulation is one model the paper solves; two solution methods or approximations of the same model are the same
+  simulation. A specimen is a physical sample the paper measures (a coated structure, a film, a substrate piece). A series is a
+  figure's set of runs or specimens that vary one quantity (introduced_in = the figure). A cited work is another publication the
+  paper names;
+- parent: for a specimen, the id of the run that made it; for a series, the id of the simulation, run or specimen it belongs to;

+- every field is present in every item; null when it does not apply;

commit fdfd3be9e0e40989423c9c24bbc7a7a6c9f243a7
Author: Seul Lee <ftk3187@athena.athena.research.northwestern.edu>
Date:   Tue Oct 20 03:47:28 2026 -0500

    P139 compiler: null = absent, fills, count ~ dimensionless, one figure-set fallback
    
    validate(): a missing field is a null; a record drops only on an enum/type violation
    (and type null, logged); after validation null = absent. Fills: statement <- quote when
    null (logged), parent null -> paper row (parent_null, flagged per row), label <- quantity
    id, kind <- stated (P138). canon(): count compares as dimensionless. figures(): the one
    fallback, logged: a figures.json set that no pass-0 series names becomes a series under
    the paper row (how inferred); its entities and curve rows are built, the row type from
    the curve's kind (logged), nothing else inferred. Null-safe pass-0 fields.
    audit.py: parent_filled column (yes/no, T5/T6 rows); the cast fills every field with null.
    score.py: parent_filled counts in the summary.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
